result.reason: The redline removes the stated three-year take-or-pay commitment but still permits minimum commitments in signed Order Forms, so it does not achieve the preferred no-minimum position. It also does not meet the fallback because any permitted minimum is not expressly limited to the current 12-month term or reducible on 30 days' notice. The shortfall-payment concept resembles a true-up, but the added suspension and release provisions go beyond what is needed, and “shall credit all amounts paid” is imprecise. The changes remain confined to minimum-commitment mechanics and do not appear to disturb unrelated commercial intent. The margin comment cannot cure the operative language.
